chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) said: "Among the character traits of the Prophets (peace be upon them) is the love of women."
ai.seo_question: What is considered a characteristic trait of the Prophets regarding women?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him) identifies the love of women as a characteristic trait (akhlaq) of the Prophets (peace be upon them), highlighting the natural and virtuous aspect of marital affection in prophetic tradition. This narration, found in the chapter on choosing spouses, underscores that romantic attachment is not merely a biological impulse but a spiritual quality shared by the divine messengers, thereby sanctifying the marital bond within Shia ethical framework.
